jobs.title: Financial Analyst Accounts Payable FEMALE (E-commerce) Dubai, Al Qusais
jobs.description:
**Financial Analyst \- Accounts Payable \& Receivable**   
**(Processing Orders, Completing statements) Skilled with experience**

**Sending quotations to customers, sales entries, purchases entries, making reports on our crm platform**

**\- This job requires:**

* Good Clerical or accounting background and good in MS office
* Good pronunciation and communication skills
* Ability to work independent (quick learners)
* Flexible about time to assure that work is done before leaving the office

we are **located in Dubai, Al Qusais**

**Make sure that you are:**

(1\) available to join immediately only (currently unemployed)  
(2\) relevant work experience

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract

Pay: AED3,500\.00 \- AED4,500\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* ARE YOU FOCUSED AND WELL ORGANIZED? QUICK LEARNER?
* YOUR AGE / CIVIL STATUS / NATIONALITY
* WHAT RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE YOU HAVE?
* ARE YOU READY TO JOIN? VISA STATUS?
* CLERICAL SKILLS /MS OFFICE?
* WHAT PART OF DUBAI YOU ARE CURRENTLY RESIDING?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Admin or Accounting: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
